records.title: Known-object test, TOI-2666.01
records.summary: Known-object test on TOI-2666.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 10, 3.5, 5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 0.5%, 0.5%, 0.5% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 20%, 30%, 30%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 59 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 32 distinct event(s), 3 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2461049.1644 (ΔT 1790.01 d); 52 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.

Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3, 3, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 10%, 0%, 0%). records.title: Known-object test, TOI-289.01
records.summary: Known-object test on TOI-289.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2%, 2%, 2%, 2%, 2%, 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Residual screen: 75 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 28 distinct event(s), 11 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.

checks.name: Product integrity (SHA-256)
checks.note: 6 product(s) from MAST checksummed at first retrieval

checks.name: Known-signal recovery (positive control)
checks.note: no retrieved light curve covers a catalogued transit epoch

checks.name: Calibrated false-alarm threshold (sign-flip null)
checks.note: screen run at each light curve's own k* (≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, ≤2.5; ≤ 0 persistent null events outside the veto)

checks.name: Synthetic signal injection–recovery
checks.note: completeness for the reference box (2000ppm_4h) at each light curve's k*: 30%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 10% (pass mark 90%); 90%-completeness depths are in calibration.json

checks.name: Catalogue cross-match
checks.note: 1 target(s) × 4 services, radius 30″; 4 answered, 0 errored; results in the ledger prior_art table

checks.name: Period aliases (repeat events)
checks.note: catalogued transit not recovered; no reference depth

checks.name: Light-curve suitability for the residual screen
checks.note: 6 light curve(s) screenable

checks.name: Target-to-Gaia identification (proper motion propagated)
checks.note: TOI-289.01: Gaia DR3 4919562197762515456 at 0.00" (propagated 2016.0 → J2015.5; 0.01" unpropagated, proper-motion shift 0.01")

checks.name: Stellar priors (Gaia colour and parallax)
checks.note: TOI-289.01: dwarf priors not applied — RUWE 1.4266833 ≥ 1.4 (or missing): astrometry may be perturbed

checks.name: Blend and dilution census (Gaia DR3 cone)
checks.note: TOI-289.01: 2 Gaia neighbour(s) within 52.5", contamination 0.04%; depth 5520 ppm (catalogue depth); none bright enough to produce it alone

checks.name: Pointing and quality census per event
checks.note: 11 persistent event(s), 0 clean; BJD 2459062.0828 suspect: earth point (within ±0.25 d), manual exclude (within ±0.25 d), momentum dump (within ±0.25 d), MOM_CENTR1 z=+6.4, POS_CORR1 z=+7.2, POS_CORR2 z=+5.4; BJD 2459062.2509 suspect: MOM_CENTR1 z=+5.8, POS_CORR1 z=+8.7; BJD 2459083.5914 suspect: scattered light 2 (within ±0.25 d), SAP_BKG z=+13.2; BJD 2460893.6789 suspect: SAP_BKG z=+11.9

checks.name: Moving objects at screen-event epochs
checks.note: 11 event epoch(s) queried in SkyBoT (observer C57, r=600"); no known object bright enough within 63" plus its motion at any queried epoch (supports, does not prove, a non-asteroid origin); 4 epoch(s) not answered

checks.name: Independent repetition (other MAST collections)
checks.note: no repeat candidate with allowed period aliases

checks.name: Independent-epoch confirmation (ZTF)
checks.note: no repeat candidate with allowed period aliases

checks.name: Variable-catalogue collision (VSX)
checks.note: TOI-289.01: no VSX entry within 10"

checks.name: Object-class guard (SIMBAD)
checks.note: TOI-289.01: TOI-289 otype ** (multiple) at 0.4"

records.title: Epoch audit of campaign target positions
records.summary: The TOI-table target positions in the campaign specs were labelled J2000.0 but are at the Gaia DR2 epoch J2015.5 for 77 of 78 targets (TOI-6663.01 carries a Gaia DR1 position, J2015.0); none is at J2000.0. Verified against Gaia DR3 propagated positions and direct DR2/DR1 matches; labels corrected in specs, scaffolds and runners.

checks.name: Every query answered
checks.note: 76/76 Gaia DR3 cones and 10 DR2/DR1 cones returned HTTP 200

checks.name: Unique Gaia match per target
checks.note: nearest match is the brightest source in the 10 arcsec cone for 78/78

checks.name: Proper motion large enough to discriminate
checks.note: minimum 16 yr x PM = 51 mas vs 10 mas threshold

checks.name: Epoch of the TOI-table positions
checks.note: 77 J2015.5, 1 J2015.0 (TOI-6663.01), 0 J2000.0, 0 undetermined; 3 DR3-inconsistent targets resolved by direct DR2/DR1 matches <= 1.43 mas

checks.name: Positions from non-TOI sources
checks.note: NAME_RESOLUTIONS.json (CDS Sesame), pscomppars and manual positions not audited

checks.name: Perspective acceleration / parallax in propagation
checks.note: neglected; << 1 mas over 16 yr for these stars

records.title: Known-object test, TOI-3724.01
records.summary: Known-object test on TOI-3724.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3, 3.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2%, 2%, 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Residual screen: 146 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 42 distinct event(s), 17 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.

records.title: Known-object test, TOI-3972.01
records.summary: Known-object test on TOI-3972.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 1%, 2%, 1% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 10%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 48 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 12 distinct event(s), 6 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2459892.7292 (ΔT 10.51 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.

records.title: Known-object test, TOI-5149.01
records.summary: Known-object test on TOI-5149.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 1%, 1%, 1%, 1%, 1%, 1% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 10%, 10%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 122 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 33 distinct event(s), 12 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2459431.6755 (ΔT 383.20 d); 7 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.

records.summary: Known-object test on TOI-5379.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 0.5%, 0.5% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%). Residual screen: 81 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s), forming 29 distinct event(s), 5 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2459955.2889 (ΔT 12.74 d); 1 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.

Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2%, 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 10%, 10%). Residual screen: 48 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s), forming 9 distinct event(s), 8 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2459800.0638 (ΔT 743.14 d); 34 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.

Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 1%, 1% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 30 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s), forming 10 distinct event(s), 2 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.

checks.name: Product integrity (SHA-256)
checks.note: 2 product(s) from MAST checksummed at first retrieval

checks.name: Known-signal recovery (positive control)
checks.note: BJD 2461037.4553: recovered, depth 7511 ± 145 ppm (catalogue 4244 ppm)

checks.name: Calibrated false-alarm threshold (sign-flip null)
checks.note: screen run at each light curve's own k* (3, 3.5; ≤ 0 persistent null events outside the veto)

checks.name: Synthetic signal injection–recovery
checks.note: completeness for the reference box (2000ppm_4h) at each light curve's k*: 0%, 0% (pass mark 90%); 90%-completeness depths are in calibration.json

checks.name: Catalogue cross-match
checks.note: 1 target(s) × 4 services, radius 30″; 4 answered, 0 errored; results in the ledger prior_art table

checks.name: Period aliases (repeat events)
checks.note: no persistent screen event matches the catalogued depth

checks.name: Light-curve suitability for the residual screen
checks.note: 2 light curve(s) screenable

checks.name: Target-to-Gaia identification (proper motion propagated)
checks.note: TOI-941.02: Gaia DR3 3240852617846876416 at 0.00" (propagated 2016.0 → J2015.5; 0.02" unpropagated, proper-motion shift 0.02")

checks.name: Stellar priors (Gaia colour and parallax)
checks.note: TOI-941.02: Teff 5727 K, R* 1.08 ± 0.09, M* 1.04 ± 0.10, ρ* 0.83 ± 0.22 ρ☉ (dwarf sequence, M_G 4.40, no extinction)

checks.name: Blend and dilution census (Gaia DR3 cone)
checks.note: TOI-941.02: 9 Gaia neighbour(s) within 52.5", contamination 2.32%; depth 7511 ppm (measured depth of the recovered catalogued transit); 1 could produce it if fully eclipsed (brightest 3240852613549409664, 17.3", ΔG 4.52); a centroid test is needed

checks.name: Pointing and quality census per event
checks.note: 2 persistent event(s), 0 clean; BJD 2461003.3125 suspect: MOM_CENTR1 z=-31.4, MOM_CENTR2 z=+29.1, POS_CORR1 z=-40.7, POS_CORR2 z=+31.9, SAP_BKG z=+836.6; BJD 2461003.3527 suspect: MOM_CENTR1 z=-32.7, MOM_CENTR2 z=+29.5, POS_CORR1 z=-40.6, POS_CORR2 z=+33.8, SAP_BKG z=+896.3

checks.name: Moving objects at screen-event epochs
checks.note: 2 event epoch(s) queried in SkyBoT (observer C57, r=600"); no known object bright enough within 63" plus its motion at any queried epoch (supports, does not prove, a non-asteroid origin)

checks.name: Independent repetition (other MAST collections)
checks.note: no repeat candidate with allowed period aliases

checks.name: Independent-epoch confirmation (ZTF)
checks.note: no repeat candidate with allowed period aliases

checks.name: Variable-catalogue collision (VSX)
checks.note: TOI-941.02: no VSX entry within 10"

checks.name: Object-class guard (SIMBAD)
checks.note: TOI-941.02: TOI-941 otype * (star_or_other) at 0.6"

records.title: Epoch audit of campaign target positions
records.summary: The TOI-table target positions in the campaign specs were labelled J2000.0 but are at the Gaia DR2 epoch J2015.5 for 77 of 78 targets (TOI-6663.01 carries a Gaia DR1 position, J2015.0); none is at J2000.0. Verified against Gaia DR3 propagated positions and direct DR2/DR1 matches; labels corrected in specs, scaffolds and runners.

checks.name: Every query answered
checks.note: 76/76 Gaia DR3 cones and 10 DR2/DR1 cones returned HTTP 200

checks.name: Unique Gaia match per target
checks.note: nearest match is the brightest source in the 10 arcsec cone for 78/78

checks.name: Proper motion large enough to discriminate
checks.note: minimum 16 yr x PM = 51 mas vs 10 mas threshold

checks.name: Epoch of the TOI-table positions
checks.note: 77 J2015.5, 1 J2015.0 (TOI-6663.01), 0 J2000.0, 0 undetermined; 3 DR3-inconsistent targets resolved by direct DR2/DR1 matches <= 1.43 mas

checks.name: Positions from non-TOI sources
checks.note: NAME_RESOLUTIONS.json (CDS Sesame), pscomppars and manual positions not audited

checks.name: Perspective acceleration / parallax in propagation
checks.note: neglected; << 1 mas over 16 yr for these stars
